{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders and refunded orders
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Filter: only completed orders, excluding QA orders
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask]

# Check dimensions
print(f"Number of completed orders (after filtering): {filtered_df.shape[0]}")

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract rates
cat_email_rate = conversion_rates['email']
cat_paid_search_rate = conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Compute difference
difference = cat_email_rate - cat_paid_search_rate

# Print results
print(f"Conversion rate (email): {cat_email_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Conversion rate (paid_search): {cat_paid_search_rate:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
